question: Which of the following locations is famous for having a hemispherical dome - structured monument?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sanchi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanchi** is famous for its ancient Buddhist stupas.
 
• The most notable structure is the **Great Stupa**, which is a hemispherical dome.
 
• The stupa was originally built by Emperor **Ashoka** in the 3rd century BCE.
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a major tourist attraction.
 
• The stupa symbolizes the **Buddhist concept of enlightenment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Sanchi** is a small village in the Raisen district of the state of Madhya Pradesh, India. It is known for its stupas, monasteries, temples, and pillars dating back to the 3rd century BCE to the 12th century CE. The most prominent of these is the Great Stupa, which is one of the oldest stone structures in India and was originally commissioned by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka.
